description: Asks whether an unselected IIf/Switch/Choose arm that would fail (constant 1/0, CInt('q'), row-dependent 1/[Denominator] and CInt([TextValue]) on Den row 2, parameter-dependent 1/pz with pz = 0) fails the query, and when two failures are possible which one is reported, with arms and operands in both orders. Each expression is its own SELECT. Fixture r-expr-1-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
